---
title: "M: color options"
description: "A blue and cream viewer from the `backdrop`, `caption-background`, `caption-color` and `link-color` options, with no CSS."
format:
  html:
    code-tools: true
filters:
  - panzoom
panzoom:
  backdrop: "rgba(18, 52, 86, 0.92)"
  caption-background: "#f4e9d8"
  caption-color: "#3b2a1a"
  link-color: "#a0361b"
---

::: {.callout-note}
## About this page

This page **sets the viewer's colors from its YAML header**, with no CSS:
a deep blue backdrop, a cream caption band, dark brown caption text and
rust links. Every image on the page gets them. Each option sets one of the
viewer's CSS variables; [N: css-class and CSS](n-css-class.html) sets the
same variables from a stylesheet, for some pages only.
:::

## 1. Marked image {#c1 expect-open="panzoom" expect-overlay="rgba(18, 52, 86, 0.92)" expect-band="rgb(244, 233, 216)"}

![A marked image, with a [link](https://quarto.org) in its caption.](../../images/mv-0.jpg){.panzoom}

## 2. Code cell {#c2 expect-open="panzoom" expect-overlay="rgba(18, 52, 86, 0.92)" expect-band="rgb(244, 233, 216)"}

```{r}
#| panzoom: true
#| fig-cap: "A code cell's plot, on the same blue and cream viewer."

plot(pressure, type = "b", pch = 19)
```
